question.text: PMs with AUM of Rs. 1,000 crore or more (discretionary + non-discretionary) must have:

answer.text: An automated system with minimal manual intervention for funds/securities management

explanation.text: The Logic: PMs with AUM of Rs. 1,000 crore or more (discretionary + non-discretionary) are required to have an automated system with minimal manual intervention covering funds and securities management, order management and allocation, audit trail, and time stamping. The Trap: Manual-only systems do not satisfy this requirement; the rule specifically calls for automation with minimal manual intervention. Note: The Rs. 1,000 crore AUM trigger applies to combined discretionary plus non-discretionary assets, and the required automation must span funds/securities management, order management, allocation, audit trail, and time-stamping.
